intent: REFACTOR SensorMetricBoundaryPolicy: inspect the implementation for layering violations, blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and invariant gaps; improve clarity without changing the public surface or breaking tests. Spec: Telemetry Intake & Validation domain service. Constructor SensorMetricBoundaryPolicy(Map<String, SensorMetricBoundary> boundariesByMetric) (keys lower-case; defensive copy). TelemetrySample validate(TelemetrySample sample): looks the metric up case-insensitively; inside boundary -> status VALID; outside, non-finite, or metric without configured boundary -> VALIDATION_FAILED. Invariant: never throws for bad data, never drops or alters payload fields other than status. Pure, no I/O.
